next.reason: 1985 GR3: WRITE ... FROM is equivalent to 'MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1' then the WRITE without FROM. 2023 §2023:14.9.51.4 GR5 keeps the identical equivalence for identifier-1. Its additions do not touch a conforming 1985 program: FROM literal-1 is syntax 1985's format refuses, and the undefined result when the implicit MOVE overlaps applies only where identifier-1 and record-name-1 share storage, which 1985 SR1 forbids ('must not refer to the same storage area'). New syntax is not a change of meaning, so KEPT rather than CHANGED.
